title: "dicer instance snapshot delete"

Deletes a snapshot of an instance. With `--all`, deletes every snapshot of the
instance named, or of every instance if none is, asking first on a terminal.

## Usage

```console
$ dicer instance snapshot delete (INSTANCE NAME | [INSTANCE] --all) [flags]
```

Also run as `dicer instance snapshot rm`, `dicer instance snapshot remove`.

## Examples

```console
$ dicer instance snapshot delete web before-upgrade
$ dicer instance snapshot delete web --all
$ dicer instance snapshot delete --all
```

## Flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `-A`, `--all` | Delete all snapshots. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | With `--all`, do not ask before deleting. |

## Global flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `-D`, `--debug` | Trace every call to the daemon on stderr (or set `$DICER_DEBUG`). |
| `-r`, `--remote string` | Daemon to talk to: a remote's name, or an address (unix:///PATH or HOST:PORT) (default `$DICER_REMOTE`, then the current remote, then local). |
| `--timeout duration` | Give up on a call to the daemon after this long, e.g. 30s (0: never; streams such as logs -f and exec are not bounded). |
